subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding prefixes, suffixes or both with the root words given in the parenthesis:
stimulus: 0.5 x 14=7 Facebook is a social (a) _______ (network) site. It has gained much (b) _______ (popular) among the young (c) _______ (generate). Sometimes, our young generation waste their (d) _______ (value) time by (e) _______ (browse) facebook. So, in this respect parental (f) _______ (supervise) is a must. Many people (g) _______ (fine) facebook as an (h) _______ (embarrass) (i) _______ (invade) on others' (j) _______ (person) privacy. However, it plays a (k) _______ (signify) role in (l) _______ (socialize) as well as (m) _______ (nature) understanding and (n) _______ (operation).
guide_solution: (a) networking (b) popularity (c) generation (d) valuable (e) browsing (f) supervision (g) define (h) embarrassing (i) invasion (j) personal (k) significant (1) socializing (m) natural (n) co-operation
